# SATP / CLG: Session Start (paste as the first message of every later session)

Before doing anything, read satp-clg-knowledge/00-START-HERE.md and satp-clg-knowledge/00-RULES.md, and follow them. Answer from the folder first. Only call Confluence, search the repos, or run git commands when the folder does not have the answer, the answer is marked NOT SURE, or I ask about what is happening right now. If you learn something new, update the right folder file and add a line to 13-change-log.md.
